title: ZPA Private Service Edge Release Summary (2020)

blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Private Service Edge version.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes an update to address an issue where the ZPA Private Service Edges were not correctly processing updates to policy configurations.

Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
